reason: Only the direction holds: the 11 Sep sjlee 'DC is flat on public' read does not carry over above 0.25, because 0.25->0.30 on K2 = -0.005. That is already recorded as a FACT in CONTEXT 27 Sep 04:58Z. Five things fail. (1) The 'plateau at 0.15-0.25' contradicts the evidence it cites: sjlee v015 = 0.946 against v020 = 0.947, i.e. -0.001 (CONTEXT l.699-707). The scan_hyp_div_sensitivity lens reads the same numbers as 'lower bands mostly FP' (SHIFT -0.05). (2) '< ~0.00005 per fork' assumes ~20 dummy forks for the sjlee moves. The sjlee fork counts were never measured, and the stack is the older lf lineage with a different candidate pool (the finding's own caveat). (3) Its prior is the most optimistic of the three round-15 lenses, P(<=0.953) 0.15-0.25 and P(0.954) 0.55-0.65. scan_hyp_div_sensitivity has 44: 0.40/0.40/0.20 and 43: 0.50/0.28/0.22. scan_plancheck has P(>=0.955) 0.08-0.15 and P(<=0.953) 0.25-0.35. The exp60 lab for dc0.20 is 0 TP / +6 FP on 6bba. Quoting this prior in the brief would bias the user toward reading a tie as 'expected' and would understate P(NEG). (4) The action's condition, 'both 0.954 without an attributable UP', cannot be measured. The watcher's hard cap (11:30Z) does not cover 43/44 (CONTEXT 05:28Z). The two refs were submitted 9 s apart (05:28:13Z / 05:28:22Z), so they will probably co-complete, and by L5v2 rule (2) equal displays are then non-attributable by construction. (5) The substance is redundant. 'No combo takes a DC knob' and class C are already in L5v2 (1), 'no threshold neighbours, no class C, NEU never combined', and in the 04:59Z entry. 'No 0.15 rung' is already in the R15DS read table ('never dc <= 0.15'). scan_plancheck already asks for a stronger freeze on every further DC or ladder rung whatever 43/44 show. A note that closes the DC line only in the tie world leaves the 0.953 and 0.955 worlds without a rule and adds a third, overlapping read table. It has no private value: nothing here changes the finals {#37, #38}. Feasibility is trivial (a text line), but the value is ~0 and the numbers are misleading.
